SELECT p.subject_id, s.name AS subject_name, p.unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, SUM(p.planned_amount) AS planned_amount, COALESCE(SUM(p.completed_amount), 0) AS completed_amount, CAST(SUM(p.study_minutes) AS SIGNED) AS study_minutes FROM (SELECT t.subject_id, t.unit_id, d.planned_amount, 0 AS completed_amount, NULL AS study_minutes FROM daily_plan_item d JOIN task t ON t.id = d.task_id WHERE d.source <> 'REVIEW' AND d.plan_date >= #{from} AND d.plan_date <= #{to} UNION ALL SELECT r.subject_id, r.unit_id, NULL AS planned_amount, r.amount AS completed_amount, r.duration_minutes AS study_minutes FROM study_record r WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
AND r.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND r.subject_id IS NOT NULL AND r.record_date >= #{from} AND r.record_date <= #{to}) p JOIN subject s ON s.id = p.subject_id JOIN study_unit u ON u.id = p.unit_id GROUP BY p.subject_id, s.name, p.unit_id, u.name ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.id, u.sort_order, u.id

SELECT r.record_date AS record_date, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(r.duration_minutes), 0) AS SIGNED) AS study_minutes FROM study_record r WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.record_date >= #{from} AND r.record_date <= #{to} GROUP BY r.record_date ORDER BY r.record_date

SELECT r.record_date AS record_date, r.unit_id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, SUM(r.amount) AS amount FROM study_record r JOIN study_unit u ON u.id = r.unit_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.record_date >= #{from} AND r.record_date <= #{to} GROUP BY r.record_date, r.unit_id, u.name ORDER BY r.record_date, u.sort_order
